detail: Article 13 of Ley Organica del Banco Central de Costa Rica (Ley 7558) places the Bank under the supervision of the Contraloria General de la Republica, while under articles 14 and 38 the Bank's own Auditor Interno countersigns its balance sheets and financial statements; the law names no external audit firm.
source_title: Ley Organica del Banco Central de Costa Rica, Ley No. 7558 (Bufete de Costa Rica)

detail: Article 79 of Ley No. 1670 del Banco Central de Bolivia assigns external governmental control of the BCB to the commissions of the legislative chambers and to the Contraloria General de la Republica, and article 42 requires the BCB to submit its annual report and financial statements to the Contraloria within the first 120 days of each year; the law names no audit firm.
source_title: Ley No. 1670, Ley del Banco Central de Bolivia (Banco Central de Bolivia)

detail: Articles 11, 15(E) and 53 of the Carta Organica del Banco Central del Uruguay (Ley 16.696) subject the Bank to the constitutional control of the Tribunal de Cuentas and require its annual balance sheet and income statement, accompanied by an external audit opinion, to be visaed by the Tribunal de Cuentas before publication; the law names no audit firm.
source_title: Carta Organica del Banco Central del Uruguay, Ley 16.696 (IMPO, Direccion Nacional de Impresiones y Publicaciones Oficiales)

auditor: Corte de Cuentas de la Republica
detail: Articles 79 and 81 of the Ley Organica del Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador place the Bank's accounts under the Corte de Cuentas de la Republica through a Delegado Auditor who examines them under generally accepted auditing standards, while article 23(l) requires the financial statements to be audited and certified by an external auditor appointed for that purpose for no more than five consecutive years; the law names no firm.
source_title: Ley Organica del Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador (Superintendencia del Sistema Financiero)
